title: Playin Hookey Charters

services.name: Wreck Fishing Trips
services.desc: Playin Hookey Charters runs inshore and offshore fishing trips out of Rudee Inlet, Virginia Beach, Virginia. Fishing year-round, we were selected Best Fishing Charter In Virginia Beach for 2023, we offer great family trips, friend trips, sportfishing, whale watching, and dolphin sunset cruises. We have half day options and fulldays. All licenses, rods, tackle, bait and ice are provided. When there is an open date on the PHC calendar, we announce walk-on trips which can be for 1-6 people. If you are a solo angler or only have a few people and want to fish, this is a great opportunity! Small Groups can book a regular trip and we can help them fill it with a walk on trip too! Captain Bill
